title: ReadingBatch
description: A run of regularly spaced samples from one sampled stream: sample i has timestamp t0 + i * period_s. Internal transport and storage format. Carries only what a real meter reports: there is deliberately no metadata field. Semantic rules (checked by penjaga_contract.validate): quality array length equals values length; a sample is null exactly when its quality is 'missing'; seq increases by one per batch per stream.

quality.description: A single flag applying to every sample, or one flag per sample.

seq.description: Per-stream batch sequence number, used to detect gaps and measure latency.
